draft.title: Divorce
card: Divorce is the legal end of a marriage. In Australia it is granted under the Family Law Act 1975 by a family law court.
Australia has no-fault divorce. The court does not ask who caused the marriage to end, and blame is not part of the application.
The only ground is that the marriage has broken down and cannot be repaired. This is proved by showing the couple has been separated for at least 12 months.
Spouses can be separated while still living under the same roof. Divorce ends the marriage itself. Matters such as children and property are separate questions.
draft.remember: Divorce needs proof that the marriage has broken down, shown by 12 months of separation, not proof of who was to blame.

a.q: Which of these is the ground for divorce in Australia?
opts: The marriage has broken down, shown by 12 months apart
One spouse has been proved to be at fault for the split
Both spouses have agreed in writing that they want to part
The couple has gone through a period of formal counselling
a.why: Australia has no-fault divorce, so the court looks at whether the marriage has broken down, which is shown by 12 months of separation. Fault is tempting but it is not part of the ground. Agreement alone does not meet the ground either.
a.clue: The court asks about the state of the marriage, not about blame.

b.q: Tom's wife left him after he was unfaithful. Eleven months later, Tom applies for divorce. Tom's lawyer says the court will not grant it yet. What is the reason?
opts: The couple has not yet been separated for 12 months
Tom's wife has not been proved to be the one at fault
Tom was unfaithful, so he cannot apply for a divorce
The couple must first agree on who looks after the children
b.why: The ground is that the marriage has broken down, proved by 12 months of separation, and only 11 months have passed. Tom's unfaithfulness is irrelevant, because Australia has no-fault divorce and does not ask who caused the split.
b.clue: Count the months, and ignore who caused the split.

a.best: The marriage has broken down, shown by 12 months apart

b.best: The couple has not yet been separated for 12 months
